title: eludite.debug.processes input
description: The processes of this machine that a debugger could attach to, as the Attach to Process dialog lists them: id, name, command line, runtime (`dotnet`, `netfx`, `mono`, `native`, `unknown`), and whether Eludite started it (`launched_by_eludite`: the program of Start Debugging or Start Without Debugging in this session, or one of its child processes; attaching to it is class execute, to any other process dangerous). It reads the process table off the UI thread and changes nothing. Sorted by name, then id; at most 500 rows. Next: eludite.debug.attach with a `pid`.

filter.description: Only processes whose name or command line contains this text (without regard to case).
